page_number.description: One-based page number in the source document.

EvidenceRegion.title: EvidenceRegion

canonical_schema.description: Identity happy-case facts without mandatory extraction metadata.

document_type.description: Identifies this payload as national identity card.
document_type.title: Document type

full_name.description: Holder's complete name exactly as printed on the card.
full_name.title: Full name

given_names.description: All given names in their printed order when identified separately.
given_names.title: Given names

last_name.description: Surname or family name when identified separately on the card.
last_name.title: Last name

date_of_birth.description: Holder's printed date of birth, entered as YYYY-MM-DD.
date_of_birth.title: Date of birth

identity_number.description: Identity identifier printed on the card, preserving letters and leading zeros.
identity_number.title: Identity number

issuing_country.description: Country or issuing authority when explicitly extracted from the source; absent from the happy-case field contract and never guessed from a person's address.
issuing_country.title: Issuing country

issue_date.description: Date the card was issued, if printed.
issue_date.title: Issue date

validity_type.description: Explicit validity classification when available; null means not classified, never permanent. A printed expiry can establish validity without this metadata.
validity_type.title: Validity type

expiration_date.description: Printed expiry date; required when validity is fixed-term.
expiration_date.title: Expiration date

portrait_reference.description: Location of the holder's portrait in the source document.
portrait_reference.title: Portrait reference
